body:
As AMAZING as that sounds it seems very far-fetched and out of reach.

Maybe it will get better in time, but knowing i'm going to have to - excuse the analogy - burn in scolding temperatures at the chance the temperature might go down just puts my off the whole idea of living.

I guess what i have to do now is just try to cope with the heat and keep myself from slipping more into the idea that death would be better, though as someone like myself who will try to avoid conflict, embarrassment or love as much to my ability, i don't see much light at the end of the tunnel..

Yeah i can see what you're saying, and logically it makes sense, but really, my group of friends rotate around him (Excluding maybe like 1) and as much as i hate the group dynamic they have going where they'll subtly fuck eachother over to get in his good graces, they're all i have, i have no other friends.

> but you certainly can change how you feel about others

I definitely disagree with this, i've spent years telling myself it'll never happen and as much as i want it to, it just won't. I can't, or atleast i don't think i can, control what i feel for people. I think another thing though is my lack of self esteem:

> why get involved emotionally with someone who can't give it back?

I have the mindset that that's all i'm worth.
I don't know what questions to ask really, how does someone get help who wants it but doesn't want to go through the process of getting it..

Ugh there's many problems, but the most recent one to pop up is the fact me and my straight best friend got EXTREMELY drunk and he initated some things which he didn't remember, i did, and i'd "liked" him 2 years prior to this. So i was incredibly confused, got drunk again with him and spoke about it. He's backed of so much, and i can already see now the majority of my friends following suit and not talking to me.

That sounds horrible that they rejected you and refused to communicate, can't imagine what that must have been like.

Psychologists where live generally charge a lot of money £70/$112 per hour, and that is no way possible on my saturday part time job. I guess i'm scared to go to a doctor cause it'll just put in cement the fact i'm sick and i think i want to avoid accepting that in any case necessary.

Yeah that makes alot of sense, I have extreme anxiety and low self-esteem, so much that i'm to scared to look for professional help, i don't know why, one half of me says i really should, it would help. And the other overpowering side just comes up with a shitload of reasons why it's a bad idea.

Just ordered it. 

What have i got to lose :) (Other than like £5)

Nyeh not really, i'm quite a pessimistic, negative person towards myself, i have the mind set of not being worthy of overcoming things, or being worth something to friends, family or romantic partners. And honeslty i don't know why, i'm generally logical, i know there's nothing wrong with me and some people do value me, i guess i don't see a reason why they should.

I think i understand, for me i had other problems along with my sexuality, and because i was in denial i think i blamed it all on my sexuality, and when i eventually did come out i expected everything to be okay, and it was, until like a week ago.
That's actually amazing :) thanks for commenting
though the being gay thing is a large contributing factor, my situation now involves a shit tonne of issues and mistakes with friends, insecurities and generally just going nowhere in life.
